prompt: Medium shot of a person already standing at an open refrigerator, staring at a half-empty fridge — eggs, some vegetables, leftover rice visible on the shelves. The hand rests on the door, thinking, then reaches in decisively for the eggs. Soft warm evening kitchen light, 3800K, real domestic moment. Contemplative then decisive motion, the door swings gently at the end. Audio: a warm Brazilian woman's voice says in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Quarta-feira, dezoito horas, geladeira aberta pela quinta vez.' Soft fridge hum underneath. 8 seconds, 1080p.
caption:
Quarta-feira.
18h.
Geladeira aberta há 3 minutos.

Sem ideia.

Mas tem ovo. Tem arroz. Tem o que virou jantar.

Isso é a culinária real.

O que você fez com o que tinha essa quarta? 👇
